newsHighlights.title: Young docents keep Long March story alive in Sichuan
newsHighlights.summary: A group of young student docents in Sichuan are retelling the history of the Long March to visitors, keeping the spirit of that epic journey alive for a new generation.
newsHighlights.translation: 四川一群年轻的青少年讲解员正在向参观者讲述长征历史，让长征精神在新一代中延续。

newsHighlights.title: Xi on enduring spirit of Long March
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping has repeatedly emphasized the enduring spirit of the Long March, calling on the younger generation to carry forward its courage and perseverance.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席多次强调历久弥新的长征精神，号召年轻一代传承其勇气与毅力。

newsHighlights.title: Biodiversity protection calls for real actions: Editorial
newsHighlights.summary: Four years after the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework was adopted, an editorial urges governments to turn written promises into real actions to halt biodiversity loss.
newsHighlights.translation: 在《昆明—蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》通过四年后，一篇社论呼吁各国政府把书面承诺化为切实行动，以遏制生物多样性丧失。

newsHighlights.title: What stands out in China's sustainable development?
newsHighlights.summary: China's pursuit of a green path to development is drawing global attention, as sustainable practices grow across industry, energy and daily life.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国走绿色发展之路正吸引全球目光，可持续实践在工业、能源与日常生活中不断扩展。

newsHighlights.title: In Nanjing, Autumn Arrives With the Scent of Osmanthus
newsHighlights.summary: For many locals in Nanjing, a date with the famous King Osmanthus tree in Zhongshan Mountain National Park is a cherished autumn ritual passed down through generations.
newsHighlights.translation: 对许多南京市民而言，到钟山国家公园探访著名的“桂花王”是一代代传承下来的珍贵秋日仪式。

quote.quote: Education is not the filling of a pail, but the lighting of a fire.
quote.author: W. B. Yeats
quote.translation: 教育不是把桶装满，而是把火点燃。
quote.explanation: 真正的教育不是机械地灌输知识，而是激发学生内心的好奇、热情与思考力。正如四川的年轻讲解员，他们在讲述长征故事的过程中被点燃，也反过来照亮了他人。

vocabulary.example: Chinese travelers in France were urged to stay vigilant after large-scale demonstrations broke out.

vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 “Chinese travelers in France urged to stay vigilant”，中国驻法使领馆提醒公民保持安全警觉。

vocabulary.translation: 年轻讲解员把长征故事视为需要传承的宝贵遗产。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “Young docents keep Long March story alive in Sichuan”，指革命历史这一精神文化遗产。

vocabulary.translation: 四川各地博物馆举办特别活动，以纪念长征精神。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “Xi on enduring spirit of Long March”，相关新闻围绕纪念与弘扬长征精神展开。

vocabulary.example: The resilience shown by the Red Army during the Long March still inspires young people today.
vocabulary.translation: 红军长征途中展现出的坚韧精神至今仍激励着年轻人。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “Xi on enduring spirit of Long March”，长征精神的核心品质之一就是坚韧不拔。

vocabulary.example: The Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework was adopted four years ago.
vocabulary.translation: 《昆明—蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》于四年前通过。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自社论 “Biodiversity protection calls for real actions”，指全球生物多样性保护的纲领性框架。

vocabulary.example: The report highlights the importance of passing historical memory to the younger generation.
vocabulary.translation: 该报道强调了把历史记忆传递给年轻一代的重要性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “Xi highlights green path to development”，highlight 在新闻标题中常表示“强调、指出”。

pattern.pattern: keep + 宾语 + 宾语补足语（形容词 / 名词 / 现在分词）：表示“使……保持某种状态”
pattern.example: Young docents keep the Long March story alive in Sichuan.
pattern.translation: 年轻的讲解员们让长征故事在四川保持鲜活。
pattern.usage: keep 后接宾语，再接补语说明宾语的状态。例如：keep the classroom clean（保持教室干净）、keep students interested in history（让学生保持对历史的兴趣）、keep the story alive（让故事流传不衰）。在写作中用此句型可使表达简洁有力。

grammar.title: 过去分词作后置定语（Past Participle as Post-positive Modifier）
grammar.explanation: 当一个动作已经完成或表示被动含义时，常用“过去分词 + 其他成分”放在名词后面作定语，相当于一个省略了关系代词和 be 动词的定语从句。例如：the framework adopted at the meeting = the framework which was adopted at the meeting。这种结构在新闻英语中非常常见，能让句子更紧凑。
examples: Four years after the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework adopted at the 15th meeting of the Conference of the Parties, calls for real actions are growing louder.
The spirit carried forward by the young docents in Sichuan continues to inspire visitors from all over the country.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 zɪl 上，注意 /z/ 不是 /s/；li 读作 /li/，尾音是轻快的 /əns/，整体节奏为 ri-ZIL-yəns，切勿读成“瑞-赛-伦斯”。
examples: The resilience of the Red Army during the Long March remains a powerful lesson for young people.
Good education builds both knowledge and resilience in children.

reading.title: Keeping the Story Alive: Young Docents in Sichuan
reading.content: In a museum in Sichuan, a group of young docents are giving visitors a vivid account of the Long March. Most of them are students in their teens. Before standing in front of the audience, they spend weeks reading historical materials, memorizing dates and rehearsing their presentations. Their teachers say the experience helps them grow not only as confident speakers but also as thoughtful young people. When visitors ask difficult questions, the young guides learn to think on their feet and to answer with patience. One fifteen-year-old docent said that telling the story again and again makes her feel much closer to history than any textbook could. Through their work, the enduring spirit of the Long March — resilience, solidarity and hope — is passed down to a new generation. Education, after all, is not only about books. It is also about keeping a story alive and letting it shape the future.
reading.translation: 在四川的一家博物馆里，一群年轻的讲解员正在为参观者生动地讲述长征故事。他们大多是十几岁的学生。在站到观众面前之前，他们要花数周时间阅读史料、记忆年代并排练讲解。老师们说，这段经历不仅让他们成长为自信的讲述者，也让他们成为有思想的年轻人。当参观者提出难题时，年轻的讲解员学会随机应变，耐心作答。一位十五岁的讲解员说，一遍遍讲述这段故事，让她比读任何课本都更贴近历史。通过他们的工作，历久弥新的长征精神——坚韧、团结与希望——传递给了新一代。毕竟，教育不只是书本知识，它也是让故事保持鲜活，并让故事塑造未来。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily 报道「Young docents keep Long March story alive in Sichuan」及「Xi on enduring spirit of Long March」改写，用于英语教学目的。
